name: @qf-jarvis/riya-conversation-evolution
description: QF Jarvis Riya conversation evolution semantics (RWC-P4A, ADR-0098). The PURE, channel-neutral domain logic that takes one RiyaConversationContinuityStateV1 plus a strict bounded batch of already-produced field observations and returns a deterministic evolved state and the next question plan. It owns the provenance merge (origin-ranked, equal-rank-later-wins, user_confirmed never overwritten from below, user-origin-only CLEAR), the NeedDiscovery rebuild through the canonical createNeedDiscovery, the INTRO..SUMMARY phase reducer, and the exactly-one continuityRevision increment per changed batch. It is ONE Riya: nothing here is web- or WhatsApp-specific and there is no channel field. It does NOT parse natural language, invoke a model, read a clock, use randomness, touch a database, perform a compare-and-set, call QuickFurno Core, or reach CONTACT/CONSENT/COMPLETE -- RWC-P4B owns live extraction and persistence composition, and RWC-P6 owns summary confirmation onward. No transcript, history, evidence quote, contact detail, consent, canSubmit, lead, vendor, package, price or business authority. Depends on @qf-jarvis/riya-agent, @qf-jarvis/riya-conversation-continuity and zod.
